full_judgment: 8. Mr. Hafizullah, has also pointed out the plaint of another suit being Title Suit No. 237 of 2002 annexed by way of supplementary affidavit and marked as Annexure-F, a suit brought by the Chairman of Tamizuddin Khan Trust as plaintiff imp leading 4 person as defendants which includes both the accused persons who are petitioners before us and in that suit brought on behalf of the said trust the plaintiff prayed for (a) decree for declaration that the properties described in the schedule A to the plaint is the property of the plaintiff trust, (b) a decree for khas possession of B and C schedule property after evicting the defendants and their family members by removing all obstruction there from, (c) a decree for permanent injunction against the defendants from evicting the plaintiff namely Assistant Director of Archeology from the B Schedule property and from charging the nature and feature of the vacant land upon giving lease or in any other way transfer of newly constructed lo shops as described in the schedule C to any third party; (d) that a decree for manse profit of Take 20,000 per month against the defendants directing them to vacate the same from 19-10-98.
